\documentclass{standalone}
\usepackage{pgfplots}
\pgfplotsset{compat=1.18}
\newcommand{\point}[2]{\pgfextractx{\dimen0}{\pgfpointdiff{\pgfpointanchor{origin}{center}}{\pgfpointanchor{#1}{#2}}}\pgfextracty{\dimen2}{\pgfpointdiff{\pgfpointanchor{origin}{center}}{\pgfpointanchor{#1}{#2}}}\typeout{POINT #1.#2: \the\dimen0,\the\dimen2}}
\newcommand{\report}{\point{current axis}{north east}\point{xl}{center}\point{yl}{center}\point{zl}{center}\point{xt}{center}\point{yt}{center}\point{zt}{center}\point{current bounding box}{south west}\point{current bounding box}{north east}}
\newcommand{\probe}[2]{
\begin{tikzpicture}
\begin{axis}[view={30}{30},scale only axis,width=6cm,height=4cm,
  xmin=-1,xmax=1,ymin=-1,ymax=1,zmin=-1,zmax=1,enlargelimits=false,
  xtick={-1,0,1},ytick={-1,0,1},ztick={-1,0,1},grid=major,
  xlabel={$x$},ylabel={$y$},zlabel={$z$},#2,
  xlabel style={name=xl},ylabel style={name=yl},zlabel style={name=zl},
  xticklabel style={name=xt},yticklabel style={name=yt},zticklabel style={name=zt}]
  \addplot3[only marks,mark=*,mark size=1pt] coordinates {(-1,-1,-1) (1,1,1)};
  \coordinate (origin) at (axis description cs:0,0);
\end{axis}
\typeout{CASE #1}\report
\end{tikzpicture}}
\begin{document}
\probe{boxed}{}
\probe{left}{axis lines=left}
\probe{explicit}{xlabel={office AV},ylabel={gyp},zlabel={$z_i$},
  label style={font=\small,text=red,inner sep=2pt},
  xlabel style={at={(axis description cs:0.25,-0.1)},anchor=north,xshift=3pt,yshift=-2pt},
  ylabel style={at={(-0.1,0.5)},anchor=south,rotate=90,font=\large,text=blue},
  zlabel style={at={(axis description cs:1.1,0.5)},anchor=north,inner sep=3pt}}
\probe{small}{view={120}{35},ticklabel style={font=\scriptsize,inner sep=2pt},label style={font=\small,inner sep=2pt}}
\end{document}
